text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered PD-84217 — alert=router_service.route_latency_jitter threshold=0.12s group=router links: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-84217

dave: acked in PD, jumping on it

sarah: thanks — looking at graphs now, any 5xx spike?

dave: quick glance — latency p50/p95 up on router-pool-a, p50 ~80ms -> 260ms, p95 ~600ms -> 1.2s, but 5xx rate stable at 0.01%

maria: autoscaler posted an event ~2m ago, added one pod to router-pool-a

dave: thinking flapping backend or noisy GC on one node. I’m going to tail logs and check pod restarts

priya: noticed repeated alerts from different router shards — sounds like a short-lived oscillation, possible network hiccup in AZ-3

sarah: if it's AZ-local, no broad customer impact, but we should prevent noisy pages. hold for 2 mins and see if resolves automatically

incident-bot: PD note: 1x acknowledgement (dave). Incident assigned to dave. Autosilence rules: none matched

dave: tail logs from router-7f6c:```
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z WARN route latency 0.45s shard=router-7f6c conn=peer-12
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z INFO reconnecting backend host=bk-23 zone=az-3
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z ERROR request timeout id=abcd1234
```

dave: cordon + restart one pod that shows repeated reconnects

# command
kubectl -n infra cordon router-node-az3-17 && kubectl -n infra delete pod router-7f6c-abcde

maria: K8s event: pod restarted, new pod came up on router-pool-a-2

sarah: watching metrics — latency dropping back down, p95 trending to 180ms

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert condition cleared for PD-84217 — auto-resolved (monitoring)
dave: confirmed auto-resolve, no sustained error rates, no user-facing 5xx increase. Marking no customer impact (:white_check_mark:)

priya: creating a short-term suppression rule for duplicate route_jitter alerts across router shards to reduce noise — will open PR to infra-alerting repo

maria: added a note to the incident board: "Transient AZ-3 network jitter caused brief router latency spike; autoscaler added capacity; pod restart cleared noise."

sarah: @kevin — handing off to you for the next window in case it recurs. main action: watch router-pool-a host metrics and infra-alerting PR link: https://git.local/infra/alerting/pulls/42

kevin: thanks, I'll keep an eye for the next hour. If it repeats, escalate to networking team.

dave: leaving postmortem stub in /incidents/PD-84217, will fill if we see recurrence. nice quick resolve team :thumbsup:

priya: follow-up todos: 1) suppression PR, 2) add runbook step to check autoscaler events, 3) verify AZ network flaps with cloud provider logs

sarah: closing thread, reopened if more pages come in.
